customerJourneyStories.name: Measurement data adoption journey
customerJourneyStories.summary: A journey from awareness of RIPE NCC data to trusted repeatable analysis and integration.

stages.narrative: A routing event, outage, policy question, country study, procurement review, or public-interest investigation creates a need for neutral Internet data.

media.title: Internet Measurement Researcher and Public Analyst journey stage 1: Trigger
media.alt: Enterprise journey panel for stage 1 of "Measurement data adoption journey": Trigger.

stages.narrative: The analyst discovers RIPE Atlas, RIS, RIPEstat, or RIPE country reports through search, academic references, peer recommendations, conference talks, public agency briefings, or open-data catalogs.

media.title: Internet Measurement Researcher and Public Analyst journey stage 2: Discovery
media.alt: Enterprise journey panel for stage 2 of "Measurement data adoption journey": Discovery.

stages.narrative: The analyst evaluates whether RIPE NCC data is suitable by checking coverage, freshness, methodology, trust, API stability, licensing terms, and bias risks.

media.title: Internet Measurement Researcher and Public Analyst journey stage 3: Evaluation
media.alt: Enterprise journey panel for stage 3 of "Measurement data adoption journey": Evaluation.

stages.narrative: The analyst runs sample RIPEstat queries, downloads RIS or Atlas data, and validates early findings against other sources.

media.title: Internet Measurement Researcher and Public Analyst journey stage 4: Trial
media.alt: Enterprise journey panel for stage 4 of "Measurement data adoption journey": Trial.

stages.narrative: RIPE NCC APIs and datasets become part of notebooks, dashboards, incident reports, policy briefs, or operational monitoring.

media.title: Internet Measurement Researcher and Public Analyst journey stage 5: Active Use
media.alt: Enterprise journey panel for stage 5 of "Measurement data adoption journey": Active Use.

stages.narrative: The analyst keeps using RIPE NCC data because source provenance, public accessibility, and repeatability reduce argument and integration cost.

media.title: Internet Measurement Researcher and Public Analyst journey stage 6: Reuse
media.alt: Enterprise journey panel for stage 6 of "Measurement data adoption journey": Reuse.

top.name: Trusted reusable Internet evidence
top.description: Increase successful external reuse of RIPE NCC datasets, APIs, and analysis outputs.

children.name: Public API availability
children.description: Maintain reliable availability for public RIPEstat, Atlas, and dataset APIs.

children.name: Dataset freshness SLA attainment
children.description: Increase datasets published within expected freshness windows.

children.name: Analysis provenance coverage
children.description: Increase public analyses with cited data versions, caveats, and methodology notes.

children.name: Measurement vantage point adequacy
children.description: Increase country or regional analyses meeting minimum vantage-point coverage rules.

top.name: Public information-service reach
top.description: Increase responsible use of RIPE NCC neutral data services by operators, researchers, and public-interest stakeholders.

children.name: RIPE Atlas probe network size
children.description: Grow the RIPE Atlas probe network while preserving geographic and network diversity.

children.name: API integration accounts
children.description: Increase active API users with sustained monthly usage.

children.name: Published dataset citation quality
children.description: Increase external publications that cite source, date, and methodology when using RIPE NCC data.

children.name: Data misuse or clarification rate
children.description: Reduce public-data support cases caused by misunderstood caveats or inappropriate comparisons.

productStrategy.vision: Make RIPE NCC the default neutral data foundation for understanding Internet resources, routing, reachability, and regional Internet development.

timeHorizons.focus: Improve API reliability, dataset metadata, and analysis caveats.
Help analysts combine registry, routing, measurement, DNS, and geolocation data without brittle custom work.
Become a public-interest Internet observatory with reusable evidence products and clear limits.
